key_insight: Search-for-Gradient restarts stalled optimisation by searching for trainable regions within otherwise flat variational quantum algorithm landscapes.
engineering_relevance: The framework can augment existing VQA optimisers to reduce stagnation when informative gradients exist elsewhere in parameter space.
method: Detect stalled parameter updates caused by vanishing gradients.
Search sampled parameter points for nonzero gradients.
Restart local optimisation in a discovered trainable region.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved optimisation on synthetic structured-flat functions and a quantum-circuit cost landscape, alongside theoretical estimates of jump counts and escape probability.
watch_item: The method requires a trainable region of nonzero measure and cannot escape if that region has zero measure.
paper_title: Search-for-Gradient: Search-Based Restarts for Optimisation in Structured Flat Landscapes of Variational Quantum Algorithms
